description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the (Direct Assessment : Pairwise Ranking) Merging Ratio on the x-axis and two performance metrics on the dual y-axes: Direct Assessment Pearson Correlation (left y-axis, linear scale from 0.500 to 0.675) and Pairwise Ranking Agreement Accuracy (right y-axis, linear scale from 50 to 80). The x-axis ranges from 1:9 to 9:1 in increments of 0.9, representing the proportion of direct assessment data to pairwise ranking data used in merging. Three distinct lines are plotted: a green line with circular markers representing Direct Assessment Correlation, which starts at approximately 0.500 at 1:9, rises sharply to a peak of 0.675 at 5.5, then declines to about 0.600 at 9:1; a blue line with no markers representing Pairwise Ranking Accuracy, which begins near 80 at 1:9, remains relatively flat until 4.6, then drops steeply to approximately 50 at 9:1; and a black line with square markers representing a third metric (labeled as “Direct Assessment Correlation” in the legend but visually distinct from the green line), which starts at 0.575, rises gradually to a peak of 0.625 at 5.5, then declines to about 0.525 at 9:1. The plot suggests an optimal merging ratio near 5.5 for both direct assessment correlation and the black-line metric, while pairwise ranking accuracy degrades as the merging ratio shifts toward more direct assessment data.
